methods.what: Table of powers of the primitive root 3 modulo 257 (exponent → residue)
Indices (discrete logarithms base 3) of −1 and small primes modulo 257
Index table modulo 73 with primitive root 5 (number → index)
Gaussian periods for p = 13: the cosets of the cubic residues {1,3,9}
Combining 3-term periods into 6-term periods, with their product relation
Difference of two 3-term periods expressed as a square root
Explicit values of the quadratic periods for p = 13
Symmetric 4×4 parametrised array whose rows and columns have prescribed sums (cyclotomic-number type scheme)
